noticias.texto: Brandon Woodruff, who hasn't pitched in a game since July 4 due to a shoulder injury, took the place of Chad Patrick on the Brewers' World Series roster.

noticias.texto: This year's World Series features the two teams with the best records in their respective leagues -- who both also call domed stadiums home.

noticias.titular: Jacob Misiorowski brings tall tales -- and talent -- to World Series
noticias.texto: Misiorowski does amazing things with a baseball. It turns out, that's not the only incredible thing about him.

noticias.texto: Nic Lentz and Gabe Morales will make their World Series umpiring debuts, part of a crew headed by James Hoye for the matchup between the Brewers and Rays.

noticias.texto: It's been a long, long wait for Milwaukee fans to see their team play again on baseball's biggest stage in October.

noticias.texto: The famed ESPN broadcaster has a deep passion for Tampa Bay baseball, and he'll be in the stands for the Rays' World Series home games.
